concerns.text: The plan cites 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/foundry-ml/dataset_thermalcond_aflow/resolve/main/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet' for AFLOW thermal/elastic properties. However, the research question (FR-001, US-1) explicitly requires 'formation energy, band gap, and bulk modulus'. The cited URL targets 'thermalcond' (thermal conductivity), not bulk modulus or formation energy. This dataset does not provide the required target variables for the primary analysis. A different AFLOW source containing bulk modulus/formation energy (e.g., the main AFLOW-ML repository or a specific HuggingFace collection for those properties) must be cited.

The plan lists 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/kjappelbaum/chemnlp-oqmd/resolve/main/targets.csv' for OQMD. While this URL may be reachable, 'chemnlp-oqmd' is typically a text/chemistry NLP dataset, not the full structural/property database required for computing Magpie descriptors (which need crystal structures/compositions) and bulk modulus. The plan needs to cite the actual OQMD structural dataset (e.g., from the OQMD website or a specific HuggingFace repo containing the full 'oqmd' structural data) to ensure the 'composition' and 'targets' fields required by FR-002 and US-1 are present.
